points.description: First blank: rainfall intensity (or rainfall depth/rate of rainfall; rainfall intensity is the model term).
points.partial_credit: Half mark if only 'rainfall' or 'precipitation' is given without intensity/depth/rate.

rubric.notes: Full marks (2) for rainfall intensity and time, in either order. Give part marks if rainfall is named only vaguely (e.g. 'rainfall' or 'precipitation') or only one blank is right. Give no marks for unrelated answers such as discharge, runoff or stage; a hydrograph-type answer (discharge vs time) earns only the time mark.
